pets.primary: Change in C minus U geometric margin at depth 3 or 9 relative to depth 6.
pets.secondary: Change in CU minus UU; accuracy and raw cosine gap accompany geometric margin.
pets.aggregation: Match images, tasks and training seeds or ordered seed pairs across depths. Average fixed runs within each row, then paired image bootstrap with original equal-task/equal-class weights.
pets.uncertainty: All estimates use the same image resamples across depths and methods. Intervals condition on these tasks and fixed runs. Adjust the two depth changes across two datasets separately for each endpoint family and metric.
